topic: Matter Properties: Absorb, Float, Sink, Decay
key_concepts: Matter is everything around us and exists as solid, liquid, or gas.
Absorb means to take in liquid in a natural or gradual way.
Porous materials have small holes that allow air or liquid to pass through.
